observations: Photo 0: Front view of a white Dell all-in-one PC with a large screen, bezel, and stand. The Dell logo is visible at the bottom center. A small Intel logo is on the bottom left. The screen is off, reflecting the room and a ceiling light.
Photo 1: Similar front view, slightly different angle. Reflections show a person holding a phone and shelves with boxed electronics in the background.

Photo 2: Back view of the same unit. White casing with Dell logo centered. A vertical stand with a circular hole is attached. Ports are visible on the left side of the back panel. No model number or serial visible.
No photos show the screen turned on, no keyboard or mouse, no internal components, no power cable or accessories.
The seller claims it is a touchscreen, clean, fast, ready to use, and specifies Intel Core i5-7200U.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 2 show a Dell all-in-one unit. The seller's claim of 'touchscreen' is unverified as no photo shows touch interaction or confirms touchscreen capability.
Photos show reflections and some smudges on the screen; no close-up of the body or ports to verify cleanliness.
Performance cannot be assessed remotely. No benchmark or system specs beyond CPU are visible.
No photo shows the device powered on, no accessories (keyboard, mouse, power cable) are visible. Cannot confirm if it boots or has OS installed.
CPU model is not visible in any photo. The seller's text claims it, but no proof is provided in images.

risks.proof: A video or photo showing touch interaction on the screen, or a close-up of the screen edge showing a touchscreen digitizer.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-touchscreen, which reduces value significantly.

risks.risk: Device does not power on or is not functional
risks.proof: A video showing the device turning on, booting, and displaying the desktop or OS.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, which drastically reduces value.

risks.proof: Photos showing all included accessories laid out next to the unit.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing accessories, which reduces value.

risks.risk: CPU model is not Intel Core i5-7200U
risks.proof: A photo of the system information screen (e.g., Windows About or BIOS) showing the CPU model, or a sticker on the back with model/serial.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown CPU, which reduces value due to uncertainty.

risks.risk: Physical damage or wear not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the screen, bezel, stand, and ports for scratches, cracks, or loose parts.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Video or photo showing the device powered on and booting.
Photo of the screen with touch interaction (e.g., finger swiping or tapping).
Photo of the system information screen showing CPU model and RAM.
Photo of all included accessories (keyboard, mouse, power cable).
Close-up photos of the screen, bezel, stand, and ports for damage.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Dell all-in-one PC, but critical claims (touchscreen, CPU model, functionality, accessories) are unverified or unverifiable from current photos. Hidden risks like non-functionality or missing accessories could drastically reduce value. Proof is needed to price accurately.
